guide.text: Sinestro's signature gear. Increases Spiritual Amplification, grants an additional Spiritual Amplification bonus at low HP, and restores Energy on kills. These effects perfectly support Sinestro's Kill Bonus mechanics, where he's stronger with each kill, and his damage chains across multiple targets.
